name: LLNL Manufacturing Workshop
org: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) Science Education Program
what_you_do: A free three-day summer workshop at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory. Students design and make objects with 3D printing and computer design, and learn about machining and process manufacturing.
who_can_apply: Must be 16 or older at the start of the workshop. No GPA requirement and no experience needed. Students 18 at the start must be U.S. citizens. You must be allowed to enter the Lab under federal law (2025 NDAA).
pay_detail: Free to attend. Lunch and snacks provided.
duration: Three days. In 2026: June 29 to July 1, 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application opened Jan 19, 2026 and closed Feb 26, 2026 (11:59 p.m.). 2027 dates are not posted yet. Expect a January opening again.
how_to_apply: Online application only. No recommendation letter needed.
notes: The page does not list a grade level or a region rule. Competitive and space is limited. Bring your own laptop and transportation. The 2025 NDAA rule generally blocks citizens of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea who do not also hold U.S. citizenship. Contact: stem-education@llnl.gov.
